mcq_drop.why: obscure news trivia (CM's demands), no fact-based answer

pyq_bad.why: garbled: stem fused with explanation; options truncated
garbled: explanation of another question with unrelated options (demonetisation)
garbled: pair options missing their second halves

patterns: PYQs are direct institution-function items: ECGC = export credit insurance, EXIM Bank set up 1982, IBEF 1996, MMTC/STC as trading agencies
Definitions recur: letter of credit produced by importer, duty drawback = refund of import duty, import quota = QR, rules of origin
Acronym full forms (EPCG) and scheme-sector links (NIRVIK = exports) are typical single-fact shapes
FTP period/date questions (2004-09, FTP 2023 open-ended) appear
App adds 2025-26 missions (EPM, RELIEF, Niryat Disha) and FTP 2023 features beyond PYQ depth
